{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for LOYAL customers, completed status, and exclude QA orders
loyal_completed_real = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & 
                           (df['status'] == 'completed') & 
                           (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute and print the number of valid orders
num_valid_orders = len(loyal_completed_real)
print(f'Number of valid completed orders from LOYAL customers: {num_valid_orders}')

# Compute and print the total revenue
total_revenue = loyal_completed_real['revenue_clean'].sum()
print(f'Total revenue from valid completed orders: {total_revenue}')

# Compute and print the mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed_real['revenue_clean'].mean()
print(f'Mean revenue of valid completed orders from LOYAL customers: {mean_revenue}')

# Return the mean for submission
mean_revenue"}
